creations.title: Demo — The Window at Dawn
creations.subtitle: Sample poem · Not a published work
creations.excerpt: A piece of light settles on the window after the night's silence — like the promise of a new day.
creations.description:
Demo poem — not a real published work.

At the end of the darkened night
soft light falls on the window,
a distant bird calls to say—
the beginning of the path is still good.

Through the dust-covered day
I keep a little hope burning,
small dreams like the dawn
return to open the mind.

creations.title: Demo — The Last Bus Home
creations.subtitle: Sample short story · Not a published work
creations.excerpt: A blue notebook left behind at a rain-soaked bus stop teaches two strangers how to talk.
creations.description:
Demo short story — not a real published work.

Even after the rain stopped, water kept dripping from the tin roof of the bus stop. Rashed noticed the blue notebook lying in a corner of the bench and picked it up. On the first page was a single line: “The one who waits will also, one day, arrive in someone's story.”

Just as the last bus's lights appeared, an elderly woman standing nearby said the notebook belonged to her granddaughter. Rashed handed it to her. She smiled gently and said, “Today I did not have to wait for the bus alone.”

creations.title: Demo — Letters from Across the River
creations.subtitle: Sample novel introduction · Not a published work
creations.excerpt: A fictional story of decisions and memories across two generations, traced through letters found in an old post office.
creations.description:
Demo novel introduction — this is not a real or published novel.

While renovating a post office that is slowly closing in a fictional riverside town, Neera finds several letters without addresses. The letters are dated many years ago, yet each holds a question that remains unanswered in the town today. Searching for the letter writer, Neera learns to see her own decisions, her family's memories, and the town's changing relationships anew.

This sample exists only to test the story summary and detail layout; it does not imply any real manuscript or publication.
